messages:
eric: opening channel — seeing sudden spike of 502/504 from hosted inference in ap-southeast-1 since 11:03. p95 latency up, CS reporting ~30 customers affected. logs show many upstream resets (\"read: connection reset by peer\"). starting triage.

maria: on it. pulling region telemetry and recent deploys. @jin can you check proxy keepalive / connection reuse metrics?

jin: checking now. proxy_conn_count high, connection reuse rate low. keepalive idle median ~0.3s on edge pool. pulling last deploy config.

deploy-bot: deploy: proxy-edge v2.8.7 rolled to ap-southeast regions at 09:45 UTC.

sam: CS note — two enterprise customers already opened tickets for 504s. raising priority and sending interim message: \"we're investigating, taking mitigation steps\".

eric: mitigation plan: 1) throttle noisy tenants, 2) start rollback to proxy-edge v2.8.6 in region as canary, 3) enable per-node rate-limit while we validate. @maria coordinate canary.

maria: starting rollback canary (10% nodes) now, will monitor error rates.

ops-bot: alert — autoscaler activity high in ap-southeast-1, scaling events observed. limiting burst scale to avoid noisy neighbor amplification.

jin: found repeated TLS session rehandshake logs and short-lived upstream sockets. sample nginx snippet: ```
upstream response timeout while reading upstream, client: 10.0.0.1, server: inference, request: \"POST /v1/generate\", upstream: \"http://10.60.2.3:8080/\", host: ...
``` Suggests keepalive / socket reuse regression in v2.8.7.

eric: can we patch keepalive to 60s and roll to canary instead of full rollback? risk is short-term connection churn during restart but likely lower blast radius.

maria: agreed, patching keepalive to 60s on canary nodes first.

deploy-bot: rollback (v2.8.6) and keepalive patch triggered for canary group (5 nodes). ETA ~2m.

sam: CS update: customers report some improvement, tickets updated. will continue comms and collect repros.

jin: metrics update — canary nodes show 70% reduction in 502s and p95 latency trending down. still seeing KV cache miss spikes from a small subset of pods, likely unrelated to proxy change.

eric: good. action items to capture now: 
1) postmortem writeup with timeline and impact metrics (owner: maria)
2) add keepalive integration test to deploy pipeline (owner: jin)
3) backfill connection-reuse and TLS handshake metrics for last 7 days (owner: maria)
4) change default SO_KEEPALIVE to 60s in proxy image config and document (owner: jin)
5) improve graceful drain to avoid conn churn during quick rollouts (owner: eric)
6) CS comms follow-up and customer-specific RCA (owner: sam)

maria: I'll create the incident doc and put required graphs (error-rate, p95 latency, deploy timeline).

jin: will file a CI test and a small patch PR for default keepalive.

eric: once canary looks stable we'll finish region rollback. thanks all for quick response :thumbsup:.

ops-bot: incident: canary shows resolved at 11:12 UTC, regional rollback in progress.

eric: closing channel after rollback completes. I'll link the postmortem when published.

sam: drafted customer note and will send once final confirmation from SRE.

ops-bot: region rollback complete at 11:18 UTC. incident marked mitigated.

eric: thread closed — good job team. Will follow up with postmortem and tracked action items.
